items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 92:1
items.html: (To the question) What is a returning Makif? There are two kinds of Makifim: one is a Makif that was never in the aspect of an inner light, namely that it was not clothed in inner vessels, in the manner of the Makifim of the LAMED-MEM of the Tzelem of ZA. And there is an aspect of a Makif that comes in inner vessels at the time of the coming out of the Mochin, except that it returns and comes out at the time of the coming of the Mochin to their place, and they are the GAR of the revealed AB, that at the time of the coming out of the Mochin, the garments of the three aspects of MEM-LAMED-TZADIK are not there, and the GAR of the AB are revealed there. However, at the time of the birth of the Mochin, the GAR of the Mochin return to be clothed in the MEM of the Tzelem, which are covered Hassadim, and the GAR are compelled to depart from there to the aspect of Makifim. And so it operates always in these Mochin of the AB, and therefore those Makifim are discerned as the aspect of a returning Makif, for always at the time of birth it returns and becomes hidden from the inner vessels and becomes a Makif above them. See above, Answer 8. (Item 204).
